verdict.rationale: Muse provides a 'Forget' skill to remove information about specific topics/people, an opt-out switch for training data use, and VM data that users can inspect, edit, download, and back up. Combined these cover both deletion (Forget skill) and retention control (training opt-out, data export/inspection). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that deletion requests are honored completely and no third-party corroboration of the opt-out mechanism's effectiveness.
